name: MenuItemContent
description:
The inside of every menu row (menu, context menu, action menus, previews): icon, label,
then a trailing shortcut or chevron. One layout, so every list reads the same.
signature: ({ icon, children, shortcut, trail }: ItemContentProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown with the control, using the host platform’s modifier keys.

props.name: trail
props.description: Ancestor trail before the current item.
